about_the_game:
The Ultimate TTRPG 3D Map-Making Tool

Unleash your creativity with Master Of Realms, the revolutionary 3D Smart Hex Map Making Tool designed for tabletop RPG enthusiasts! Dive into immersive worldbuilding and craft world maps, regional maps, and city or town maps with ease. Master Of Realms lets you create stunning hex-based maps effortlessly, and you can bring them to life with 3D printing, 2D export for beautiful paper maps, or VTT export for your favorite online platforms.

Key Features:

1. 2D Export:

Bring your creations to life on virtual tabletops! Export maps in 2D formats like JPG, PNG, PDF, or VTT, with full support for FoundryVTT and other platforms. Customize your grid overlay in Hex or Square style to match your campaign needs.

2. 3D Export:

• Step beyond flat maps with true 3D exports. Share or print your realms in fully-detailed STL and 3D formats, perfect for immersive play, 3D printing, or showcasing your world in dynamic environments.

3. Customize your tiles:

Master of Realms gives you full flexibility to bring your imagination to life. Craft custom tiles from scratch, add objects of any shape, size, or style, and place them exactly where you want to create a world that’s truly your own.

4. Unparalleled Map-Making Power:

Pick a hex tile and start drawing on the grid, and watch as Master Of Realms transforms your vision into a breathtaking 3D map.

5. Streamlined User Experience:

• Save your progress effortlessly with the File Save System.

• Dive into map creation on your PC or Mac.

• Stay organized with in-app user authentication and activation (coming soon).

• Enhance your toolkit with in-app purchases (coming soon).

6. Community and Support:

• Join a vibrant community of TTRPG map makers and get inspired by their creations.

• Access comprehensive support resources to help you unleash your full map-making potential.

Get ready to become the ultimate Game Master with Master Of Realms! Create, share, and immerse yourself in epic RPG adventures like never before. Your tabletop world awaits – bring it to life with Master Of Realms.

(Note: Master Of Realms is currently in development, with features actively being implemented and optimized. Stay tuned for exciting updates!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5 5th Generation
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: You can run the application smoothly on medium graphic settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 9th Generation
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: You can run the application with high-quality settings for an optimal experience.
